dataset_metadata.name: SentinelForge evidence-context experiment
dataset_metadata.provenance: Hand-authored synthetic scenarios; no captured external or deployment telemetry
dataset_metadata.labeling_criteria: Assigned action intent is explicit in each scenario reason. No label or scenario metadata is submitted as telemetry. Context is separately configured through authenticated operator APIs. Ambiguous intent-only cases are retained as difficult examples.
dataset_metadata.independence: Scenario/template is the unit. Variants within a partition are correlated regression evidence, not independent population observations. Validation and holdout were authored during implementation; neither is representative external validation.

unit: Scenario; any emitted alert predicts suspicious. No label or scenario metadata is sent to detection.

provenance.clock_policy: One explicitly recorded UTC time for every scenario; never selected from a label

metadata.freeze_policy: Frozen before candidate detector tuning/evaluation. If holdout informs any fix, retire it as development evidence and freeze a new version. Never adjust labels, remove failures or add easy cases to repair a target.
metadata.scope: Synthetic development-time evidence; no claim of independent deployment validation or population efficacy
metadata.near_duplicate_policy: All >=0.80 candidates are published for manual review; unresolved candidate leakage invalidates an independent-holdout interpretation.

uncertainty.interpretation: Nominal binomial intervals describe this experiment only. Synthetic template variants are not independent population samples; no deployment efficacy or population FPR claim follows.

targets.basis: Unrounded point estimates; separate from uncertainty and external validity

input_audit.input_key: Canonical submitted event sequence and operator context, excluding scenario metadata
input_audit.assumptions: Deterministic detector, identical initial state and fixed processing clock; upper bound only

limitations: Synthetic experiments, not deployment efficacy or representative prevalence
Generated variants are correlated; nominal binomial intervals are not an independence claim
Any rejected/failed scenario invalidates headline metrics; no implicit benign prediction
No population FPR below 5% is established by these point estimates
